step1_analysis.description: A source-switched charge pump circuit for a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL). It uses current mirrors to source and sink current to the output node based on digital UP and DOWN control signals. Note: While the paper metadata refers to the overall VCO/Synthesizer, this specific extracted netlist is the Charge Pump sub-block.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz 2.5-mA CMOS Frequency Synthesizer with an Automatic SC Tuning Loop

I_up.description: Pump-up current sourced to the output when UP_BAR is high.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 50uA reference current injected into N_BIAS. The current is mirrored via XM4/XM8 and XM3/XM1 with a 1:1 ratio (W/L=5u/0.5u for all).

I_down.description: Pump-down current sunk from the output when DOWN_BAR is high.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mirrored via XM4/XM2 with a 1:1 ratio.

I_mismatch.description: Percentage mismatch between I_up and I_down.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matched transistor sizes should yield low mismatch, limited primarily by channel length modulation.

V_comp_max.description: Maximum output voltage where I_up remains within 10% of its nominal value.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD - Vdsat_XM1. Vdsat_XM1 = sqrt(2*Id / (upCox * W/L)) = sqrt(2*50u / (50u * 10)) = 0.45V. V_comp_max = 1.8 - 0.45 = 1.35V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS current source requires sufficient Vds to stay in saturation.

V_comp_min.description: Minimum output voltage where I_down remains within 10% of its nominal value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vdsat_XM2 + Vdrop_XM7. Vdsat_XM2 = sqrt(2*50u / (270u * 10)) = 0.19V. Vdrop_XM7 is small (~10mV). V_comp_min = 0.2V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS current sink requires sufficient Vds to stay in saturation.

I_leakage.description: Leakage current at the output when both UP and DOWN signals are low.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage of XM1 and XM2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Switches XM6 and XM7 are off, cutting off the current mirrors.

step3_testbench.description: DC sweeps to measure pump-up current, pump-down current, compliance voltages, mismatch, and leakage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
IREF VDD N_BIAS 50u

XM1 CP_OUTPUT N_PMIRROR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 N_PMIRROR N_PMIRROR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 CP_OUTPUT N_BIAS N_SW2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 N_BIAS N_BIAS N_SRC1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_SRC1 VDD GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 N_PMIRROR N_BIAS N_SW1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM6 N_SW1 UP_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N_SW2 DOWN_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

VUP UP_BAR 0 0
VDOWN DOWN_BAR 0 0
VOUT CP_OUTPUT 0 0.9

.control
  * 1. UP Current and Compliance
  alter VUP 1.8
  alter VDOWN 0
  dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
  let i_up = i(VOUT)
  meas dc i_up_nom find i_up at=0.9
  let target_up = i_up_nom * 0.9
  meas dc v_comp_max when i_up = $&target_up fall=1
  
  * 2. DOWN Current and Compliance
  alter VUP 0
  alter VDOWN 1.8
  dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
  let i_down = -i(VOUT)
  meas dc i_down_nom find i_down at=0.9
  let target_down = i_down_nom * 0.9
  meas dc v_comp_min when i_down = $&target_down rise=1
  
  * 3. Leakage Current
  alter VUP 0
  alter VDOWN 0
  dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
  let i_leak = abs(i(VOUT))
  meas dc i_leak_nom find i_leak at=0.9
  
  * 4. Mismatch
  let mismatch = abs(dc1.i_up_nom - dc2.i_down_nom) / ((dc1.i_up_nom + dc2.i_down_nom)/2) * 100
  print dc1.i_up_nom dc2.i_down_nom dc3.i_leak_nom mismatch dc1.v_comp_max dc2.v_comp_min
  
  quit
.endc
.end
